components.description: Shared record rules: referral lifecycle, criteria completeness, waitlist matching, offers and holds, consent, notifications, fee ledger, FHIR shapes
instructions: Keep it pure: no I/O, no clock reads, no randomness. Callers pass timestamps.
Every rule change ships with a test that fails without it. Refusals throw DomainError with a message a person can act on.
Matching and criteria code must never read fee terms, payer or any commercial field; the invariance and source-scan tests stay.
Assistant commands accept suggestions only; applyProposal is the patient's alone. Validate every suggested change with proposalProblem.
Fill policy numbers (hold windows, batch sizes, freshness) live in config.ts; the product name lives in PRODUCT_NAME.
Notification text carries no health details and fits one SMS; the notify tests stay.
Demo data in demo.ts is synthetic and labelled (example); never add real names, NPIs or fax numbers.

components.description: Patient app, PCP portal, specialist portal, ops and demo hub over one shared record
instructions: Views read rules and read models from @attune/domain; do not re-implement statuses, eligibility, ordering or consent in components.
Go through the store's act(); show the rule's refusal message instead of hiding the control.
Use the Attune design system (apps/web/DESIGN.md): tokens from src/design/tokens.ts and components from src/shared/ui.tsx; no raw colors, fonts or radii in views, and no status shown by color alone.
Patient app is mobile-first: text 14px or larger, no red dots or badges, no infinite scroll, no horizontal scroll at 390px, tap targets at least 44px.
Clinician portals stay usable at phone width even though they are designed for desktop.
Keep files under 400 lines; split by screen or panel.
No in-app chatbot: the patient app shows connections, suggestions waiting for her, and who read what.

components.description: Connector gateway: the MCP connector Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants use to reach her record, plus the record hub. Calls no model.
instructions: Build every record text an assistant sees with assistantContext from @attune/domain; never assemble record data here.
Assistants only queue commands for the app; the app runs them through the domain. Never write the record from the gateway.
Hub endpoints (/api/hub/*) answer only requests addressed to localhost; the connector requires a token from an active assistant link.
The gateway never calls a model and holds no model credentials; the conversation happens in her assistant's own app.
Keep the connector test (official MCP client over HTTP) passing. Synthetic data only (ADR-007).
